objectives.statement: Use å plus infinitive after verbs such as prøve, begynne, pleie, glemme, and håpe.
Use at-clauses after verbs that report speech, thought, or knowledge, such as si, tro, vite, and mene.
Diagnose and fix common complement mistakes with å, at, and bare infinitives.
Recognize bare infinitives after modals and common perception verbs as a contrast to å-infinitives.

notes: Must teach which verbs govern the å infinitive (prøve å, begynne å, pleie å, glemme å, håpe å) versus verbs that govern at-clauses (si at, tro at, vite at, mene at). Cover bare infinitive after modals and perception verbs briefly for contrast, but keep the focus on the å versus at complement split.
